metadata.Paper Title: FQuAD2.0: French Question Answering and knowing that you know nothing
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
metadata.Abstract: FQuAD2.0 is a French Question Answering dataset. It contains adversarial questions designed to test the reasoning capabilities of question answering models. We introduce a new set of 9,481 unanswerable questions, and we analyze the types of reasoning errors made by state-of-the-art models. We show that models struggle with questions requiring simple reasoning, such as identifying antonyms or swapping entities.
